summary: @ornikar/eslint-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: The package declares `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers and string-dispatch indirection (`_0x488df8`, `_0x19328d = { QkQej: '--version',... }`). It builds a URL of the form `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<V>/...zip`, downloads a Bun runtime archive to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')],...)` against the sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB opaque compiled bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, consisting of packed constant arrays and reshuffling functions consistent with a Bun-compiled/obfuscated payload. The declared package purpose is an ESLint configuration (main `index.js` contains only ESLint config); ESLint config has no need to install an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or to execute a large opaque compiled bundle through it. Installing the package runs the obfuscated payload under a freshly-downloaded runtime that bypasses Node-based tooling, in a `@ornikar` scope whose prior releases are ordinary ESLint configuration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
